answer: Because the prism weight is recomputed from the echo history each close, the comet audit makes public the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 10 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 48% of full weight. Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for each alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 19 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
